description: This file defines utility functions, classes, and type conversions related to Android camera hardware interfaces, metadata, and native handles, primarily for use within the Android camera NDK vendor implementation.

classes.name: native_handle_ptr_wrapper
classes.description: A utility class that wraps a native_handle_t pointer to enable comparison operations based on handle contents rather than raw pointer addresses.

classes.name: CaptureRequest
classes.description: A utility class inheriting from RefBase that encapsulates a camera capture request along with associated surface handles and physical camera settings metadata.

methods.name: isWindowNativeHandleEqual
methods.description: Checks if two native window handles are equal.

methods.name: isWindowNativeHandleLessThan
methods.description: Determines if one native window handle is less than another.

methods.name: isWindowNativeHandleGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if one native window handle is greater than another.

methods.name: convertToAidl
methods.description: Converts internal capture request or template ID to their AIDL representations.

methods.name: cloneFromAidl
methods.description: Clones and converts AIDL camera metadata into internal camera_metadata_t format.
